en.headline: WestK Picnic Fest opens on the Art Park lawn from Friday
en.dek: The West Kowloon Cultural District will run a harbourfront market, workshops and live music on selected dates from 18 September to 11 October, 2pm to 9pm.
body: The West Kowloon Cultural District Authority said WestK Picnic Fest will begin on Friday at the Harbourside East Lawn in Art Park, running on weekends and public holidays from 18 September to 11 October.

According to the venue’s programme page, sessions are scheduled for 18 to 20 September, 25 to 27 September, 1 to 4 October and 9 to 11 October, generally from 2pm to 9pm. Hours on 1 October will be shortened to 2pm to 6pm to make way for National Day events, WestK said.

The authority said the lawn will host a food market, live music and workshops organised with The Picnic Club Hong Kong. Picnic chairs, tables, mats, lanterns and fans can be hired from an information booth on the lawn, with listed rental fees of HK$40 to HK$50 plus a HK$100 deposit per item. A Bike & Picnic Pass is priced at HK$348 and includes a four-hour tokyobike hire voucher, a free mat and lantern rental, and a workshop voucher, the page said.

WestK said workshop places are limited and that spending HK$200 by electronic payment at designated outlets during the event can be used to redeem a workshop, subject to a daily quota. Practical details such as pass sales points should be checked against the authority’s own listing before travelling.

zh.headline: 西九野餐節周五起在藝術公園海濰草坪舉行
zh.dek: 西九文化區宣布活動於9月18日至10月11日周末及假期舉行，一般下午2時至晚上9時，設市集、工作坊及現場表演。
body: 西九文化區管理局公布，「西九野餐節」將於周五起在藝術公園海濰東草坪舉行，活動期為9月18日至10月11日，逢周末及公眾假期。
主辦單位網頁列出場次為9月18至20日、9月25至27日、10月1至4日及10月9至11日，一般開放時間下午2時至晚上9時。西九表示，為配合國慶安排，10月1日改為下午2時至6時。
當局稱草坪會設餐飲市集、現場音樂，並與野餐值樂部合辦工作坊。海濰東草坪詢問處提供摺椅、摺桌、野餐墊、燈籠及風扇租借，網頁列明租金40至50元，另收100元按金。單車野餐套票售348元，包括四小時tokyobike租車券、免費借用墊及燈籠，以及工作坊換領券。
西九指工作坊名額有限，活動期間在指定商戶電子消費滿200元可換領工作坊，須受每日名額限制。出發前應以主辦單位公布的售票及換領安排為準。
